From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nexishealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@nexishealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-05T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Technical preview scheduling + shortlist of two anchor times

Hi Priya / Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation today — really useful to understand NexisHealth's ingestion constraints and the 10k/month inference volume you mentioned. Per our call, next step is a 30-minute technical preview focused on integration points (S3 ingestion, key rotation, and latency targets).

I pulled two anchor windows that should work for our engineering leads:
- Option A: Tue Aug 8, 10:00–10:30am PT
- Option B: Wed Aug 9, 2:00–2:30pm PT

Can you confirm which of those works for your team, and whether you want the session recorded? If neither is good, send two alternatives and we'll match.

Attached: a short agenda and the discovery notes we captured. Ben (cc) will join for the architecture walkthrough; Mina will own the security/SCIM portion.

Quick ask: please confirm who from NexisHealth will join (engineer + security contact if possible) so we bring the right artifacts.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0127
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-30m-agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page) ; Nexis-Discovery-Notes.docx (DOCX, 2 pages)

Thanks Sofia — appreciate the recap. Option B (Wed Aug 9, 2pm PT) works best for our engineering lead (Tom) and our security manager (Aisha Rao). Recording is fine.

Tom will lead the technical questions — his direct is tom.alvarez@nexishealth.com. Aisha is on vacation early next week but can dial in if needed on Wed.

Two small asks before the session:
1) Can you surface any sample IAM roles or S3 presign guidance you recommend?
2) We prefer not to share production data — can you confirm a sandbox approach for the demo?

I'll wait for calendar invite.

—Priya
